# Slide Over

**Motion › Push Slide** · v1.0.0 · 28 frames at 30 fps (12–60)

The new scene slides in over the old one like a card, with a soft shadow, while the old one drifts back and dims.

[Preview video](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/slide-over@1.0.0.mp4)

## Where it is used

- Next item or chapter
- App-style navigation
- Stacked story beats

## Use it

```tsx
import { linearTiming, TransitionSeries } from '@remotion/transitions';
import { toPresentation } from './src/core';
import slideOver from './transitions/05-motion/push-slide/slide-over';

<TransitionSeries.Transition
  presentation={toPresentation(slideOver, { /* params */ })}
  timing={linearTiming({ durationInFrames: 28 })}
/>
```

Use `linearTiming`: the transition applies its own easing.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Range | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `direction` | enum | `"left"` | `left` · `right` · `up` · `down` | Direction the motion travels. |
| `dim` | number | `0.45` | 0–1 | How dark the old scene gets. |
| `drift` | number | `0.3` | 0–1 | How far the old scene moves along, as a share of the new one's travel. |
